task.title: Prove the real two-process CLI prototype
task.description: Create test-first and pass three clean real Go relay/two Node CLI runs covering offline, restart, exact retry, reply, ack recovery, duplicate suppression and plaintext absence.
task.scope: apps/cli process E2E and integration fixes proven necessary by it

acceptance_criteria: Three clean real relay/two-process runs pass.
Mutual contact trust and v2 publication precede first message; no direct in-process session setup is used.
Offline delivery, first-message decrypt, reply, process restarts and durable history pass.
Ambiguous send and ack responses recover with exact idempotent state and no duplicates.
Relay storage/logs and normal CLI output contain no plaintext/key markers.
Empty mailbox poll is encoded as envelopes:[] and accepted by the strict client.
Focused E2E plus prior CLI/workspace/typecheck and Go race gates remain green.
constraints: Read /Users/Goodea/goodea/projects/echolet/.metaproject/index.md before any repository action; load task-implementer and testing, validate paired input.
Write the process E2E before integration code changes and preserve initial RED evidence; do not weaken existing or new assertions.
Use apply_patch and keryx ctx rg; do not edit flow.json, acceptance-criteria.md, mobile code, or commit.
Use real relay routes and separate child processes/profile stores; runtime imports may only support fixture assertions/teardown, never session setup or message processing.
Bound every child/server wait, kill all processes in finally, use loopback only, and avoid secret/plaintext values in failure messages/artifacts.
Write and validate the required subagent-result; final first line STATUS:.

provenance.source_request: Implement and prove the approved Echolet CLI prototype through flow-orchestrator.
